League News

Roxbury to raise third Cup banner on October 11

The Roar will unfurl the 2026 Lewis Cup banner before their home opener against Catskill, the club's third championship in eleven seasons.

By Hal Reinhart · Jun 18, 2026
Trades

Kingpins land Bluefins blueliner Bergeron in swap for two picks

Kingston shores up its right side bringing in two-way defenseman Pascal Bergeron from Beacon for 2027 first- and third-round selections.

By Margie Costanza · Jun 12, 2026
Profile

Kowalczyk named back-to-back league MVP

The 17-year-old Roxbury center becomes the first player in HVHC history to repeat as MVP, capping a 90-point season at the junior level.

By Dom Reilly · Jun 6, 2026
League News

League scraps two-division format for 2026-27

After two years of unbalanced schedules, the HVHC reverts to a single-table eight-team format with a 42-game slate, commissioner Boyle announced.

By Margie Costanza · May 28, 2026
